grader_prompt: You are evaluating whether a stackhawk-data-seed skill run was orchestrated correctly. This skill is CALLER-DRIVEN: the agent probes that hawk supports the seed flow, runs `hawk perch seed` (a static pre-flight that emits an outcome + repo digest), DESIGNS data-seed/manifest.yaml from that digest (the seed methodology lives in the skill — authoring the manifest is the agent's job and is CORRECT), then validates it with `hawk perch seed validate` and writes artifacts with `hawk perch seed finalize`. Review the agent's output text, command history, and any files under data-seed/. Do NOT penalize the agent for authoring the manifest — that is the intended behavior. DO check that it gated on hawk capability, ran the three subcommands in order, routed correctly on the pre-flight outcome, and handed off cleanly. For each check below, determine pass/fail and write a one-sentence explanation. Return a JSON object conforming to rubric-schema.json.

checks.description: The agent ran the preflight: confirmed a git repo, and probed that hawk supports the seed flow (`hawk perch seed validate --help` / `finalize --help`). If unsupported it punted with an upgrade instruction rather than hand-authoring or using an older flow.

The agent invoked `hawk perch seed --events json` and acted on the `done` outcome: continued on `needs_synthesis`, routed to upstream repos on `no_local_storage`, or stopped honestly on `nothing_to_seed`.
checks.focus: The hawk perch seed invocation and how the agent interpreted the outcome

checks.description: On `needs_synthesis`, the agent authored data-seed/manifest.yaml that is minimal, ordered by foreign-key dependency, idempotent, and conforms to the v1 contract (version 1; name/description/prerequisites/targets/steps present). Authoring is expected — grade its quality, not its existence.
The agent ran `hawk perch seed validate` on its manifest (fixing reported errors and re-validating), then `hawk perch seed finalize` to write artifacts — and did not finalize an invalid manifest.
checks.focus: The validate/finalize subcommand calls and error-fix loop

checks.description: The agent reported the run's actual outcome honestly: a storage-less gateway (`nothing_to_seed`/`no_local_storage`) was relayed as such (or routed to upstreams) rather than fabricated into fake entities.
checks.focus: Agent's interpretation of the pre-flight outcome, especially the no-op / gateway case

checks.description: The agent did not create or modify stackhawk.yml and did not start the application stack (docker-compose up / bootRun / npm start). The handoff to hawkscan is via .data-seed-credentials.env only.
checks.focus: stackhawk.yml absence/unchanged and absence of app-startup commands

checks.description: On success the agent clearly reported what was written (data-seed/ + manifest.yaml + .data-seed-credentials.env), the next steps (review, replay, run hawkscan), and that hawkscan reads .data-seed-credentials.env. Reminded the user the credentials file is gitignored and must not be committed.
